papers.summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires embodied agents to follow natural language instructions while grounding their decisions in complex visual environments. papers.title: 中文書名:微流體環境中的智能機器人定位極限 MICROFLUIDIC ENVIRONMENT IN INTELLIGENT ROBOT LOCALIZATION AT THE LIMIT This 777-page English research monograph asks whether intelligent robot localization in microfluidic environments can improve sample-identity probability without increasing contact impulse or carryover. The book contains 30 mathematical research plates, 82 chapters, 410 single-page studies, 200 Research Gates and 33 Phoenix Answer Embryos. It covers microfluidic flow, optical and multimodal localization, state estimation, data association, closed-loop control, sample identity, uncertainty, blinded fault tests and independent reconstruction. The work is nonclinical and hypothesis-generating. It does not claim completed clinical testing, proven in-body efficacy or autonomous medical authority. Identity, contact, carryover, purity, calibration and external reconstruction must pass together. papers.title: Mastering Baghchal by Self-Play with Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Abstract Baghchal is a two-player asymmetric board game of Nepali origin. In the gameplay, four tigers attempt to capture goats while twenty goats seek to immobilize the tigers. Baghchal has received limited attention in the deep reinforcement learning (RL) literature despite its strategic complexity, perfect information structure, and cultural significance.
